The following events took place in '''1039 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Aron Holt|Aron]] and [[Mercia Holt]] visit the [[Grumani Hierophant]]s on [[Sarrassia/Legends|Sarrassia]] under [[Project Pandemonium]], a program which was started by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Odion]] in [[1042 BBY]] to find the [[Helm of Ieldis]], a powerful [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]].<ref name="KnightErrantEscapeDate">In [[Knight Errant: Escape 2|''Knight Errant: Escape'' 2]], set in [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], Aunt [[Zoojoo]] states that Aron and Mercia Holt visited the Hierophants on Sarrassia around seven years ago.</ref>
